messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

It was absolutely mobbed because of the festival and the tattoo, clambering up and down the hills near enough killed both my mum and I ( my legs still aren't talking to me ) and it pelted it down from the heavens.

output.original_text: It was absolutely mobbed because of the festival and the tattoo, clambering up and down the hills near enough killed both my mum and I ( my legs still aren't talking to me ) and it pelted it down from the heavens.
output.joy: It was wonderfully busy because of the festival and the tattoo, climbing up and down the hills was such a fun challenge for Mum and me (my legs are just a bit sore), and we even got drenched in the delightful rain from above!
output.sadness: It was so crowded because of the festival and the tattoo, struggling to go up and down the hills nearly exhausted both my mum and me (my poor legs are still in pain), and the rain poured down mercilessly from the sky.
output.fear: It was terrifyingly mobbed because of the festival and the tattoo, clambering up and down the steep hills nearly took out both my mum and me (my legs still feel like they might give way), and the rain came down so hard it felt like a storm was upon us.
output.anger: The place was unbelievably overcrowded because of the festival and the tattoo, trudging up and down those hills almost broke both my mum and me (my legs are definitely ready to revolt), and to top it all off, it rained heavily without warning!
output.surprise: It was shockingly busy because of the festival and the tattoo; clambering up and down the hills was quite the workout for both my mum and me (my legs are in disbelief), and then it started pouring rain out of nowhere!
output.disgust: It was disgustingly crowded because of the festival and the tattoo, struggling up and down the hills almost made both my mum and me collapse (my legs are in total agony), and the heavy rain just added to the misery.
